card.title: How To Fix iPhone 13 Pro No Power or No IMEI After Backglass Repair

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 13 Pro No Power or No IMEI After Backglass Repair

claims.statement: iPhone 13 Pro / Pro Max with no IMEI, no modem firmware or no power after a back glass job often has a cracked BB_PMU from the glass-cracking tool hitting the baseband area (also common on 14 Pro / Pro Max).
Look for hairline cracks on BB_PMU and a dent in the board; a high current jump on DCPS indicates a short around it.
Fix: split the sandwich at about 160–180 °C, remove underfill and the cracked BB_PMU, fit a reballed new one, rejoin the boards.
If the phone has data, update rather than restore; a baseband-faulty phone that is restored may get stuck at activation and must be restored again after repair.

procedure: Inspect BB_PMU for cracks and dents.
DCPS test the lower board; check for shorts around BB_PMU.
Verify boot current, IMEI, modem firmware, cellular.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Back-glass cracking tools used over the baseband area can crack BB_PMU.
